mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.person_name AS "personName", a.month, a.classes, a.id_card AS "idCard", a.employee_id AS "employeeId", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks, a.status FROM swm_person_schedule a WHERE a.id_card = #{idCard} AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC

SELECT COALESCE(wg.work_group_name, backup_wg.work_group_name) AS work_group_name FROM swm_person sp -- 关联最新的 fms_worker 记录（使用 EXISTS 优化性能） LEFT JOIN fms_worker w ON sp.identity_card = w.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fms_worker fw2 WHERE fw2.identity_code = w.identity_code AND fw2.create_date > w.create_date ) LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON w.work_group_id = wg.id -- 备用关联（通过swm_person表中保存的team字段关联） LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON sp.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE sp.identity_card = #{idCard} AND sp.status = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, work_group_name AS "name" FROM fms_work_group GROUP BY id, work_group_name ORDER BY work_group_name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_card) FROM swm_person_schedule WHERE month = #{yearMonth} AND status = '0'
